sourceVerification.qualification: The downloaded feed did not match the advertised checksum. Representative individual NVD API records corroborated configuration/status observations; no claim is made that all selected feed records were independently API-verified.

gitQueryControl.interpretation: Both queries omitted the target CVE. The observed query results do not establish why the record was omitted and do not override the upstream Apache advisory.

githubReleaseAssociation.meaning: The compared tag commits diverge. Their names identify versions but do not establish Git-range membership for the intervening release. The Apache advisory independently lists 10.1.31 within its affected product-version range.

proposedCapabilities.boundary: Coarse product matches, upstream release associations and scanner-finding projections do not grant VEX or mitigation proof authority.
